build_notes: Set the seven-wide outer spine against the 7×7 junction arms. Shift CP14 by +4 along the join face.
Keep the rock outside the two intersecting cuts. Close unused openings with dark wall courses until you extend the gallery.
title: Four-way crew gallery
summary: Four five-wide passages meet under a molded crossing ceiling. Each arm carries the same pale skirt and dark wall lining.
